name: Probable Futures Maps
description: Plain-language maps of heat, drought, precipitation, and flood hazards at warming levels from 0.5 to 3 °C. Pairs each map with explanatory text written for non-specialists, and offers the maps through an open API.
embedNote: No frame-blocking header seen; preview loads in an iframe

Software Licensing.note: Front end is not published; maps are served through an open API

Data Licensing.note: Maps and data under a Creative Commons licence with raw downloads

Technical Accessibility.note: Embeddable maps plus a public maps API and data API

Data Standards.note: Raster map tiles and CSV downloads; formats documented

Infrastructure.note: Hosted by Probable Futures on Mapbox; not self-hostable as a whole
